name: Aenon
line: Aenon, near Salim, was a place with plenty of water where John the Baptist baptized people while Jesus was also baptizing in the Judean countryside.

moments.title: John baptizes at Aenon
moments.text: John was baptizing at Aenon near Salim because the water was plentiful there. People kept coming to be baptized.

moments.title: John's joy in Jesus
moments.text: John's disciples told him that everyone was going to Jesus. John said he was not the Christ but was sent ahead of Him, and his joy in the bridegroom was complete.
